page.overview:
What is Angels of Vigilance?

They have stood silent vigil over the Eye of Terror as sentinels against the encroaching forces of Chaos for nearly ten standard millennia.

The origins of the Angels of Vigilance are shrouded in mystery. It is suspected that the Chapter came into existence during the Second Founding, but it is unknown from which First Founding Space Marine Legion its gene-seed originates.

Given the monastic nature and unflinching devotion to duty of the Space Marines within the Chapter's ranks, it is believed that they may be one of the Dark Angels' Successor Chapters. However this is unconfirmed and certainly the Chapter is not listed in the Apocrypha of Davio as such.

The fortress-monastery of the Angels of Vigilance is a gigantic orbital dock circling the world of Pervigilium. The Pervigilium System is situated just outside the Cadian Gate, the stable corridor of space in the Segmentum Obscurus that leads from the Eye of Terror to Terra.
